name: Horn is a living ally
notes: Story bible §4.2: Brother Horn was befriended (winning the Trial of Horns also sets horn.befriended) and is still alive (horn.fate, §4.4). Gates what an ally Horn gives: Hornfolk lore, the crypt shortcut and fighting at the player's side. For the Warden encounter (mw-e13.14) and Act III.
